# ezghcloud_project (Data Source)

Look up an existing project by API identifier.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project API identifier.

### Read-Only

- `folder_id` (String) Folder identifier, or null for the organization root.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization from the provider configuration.
- `slug` (String) Canonical project identifier used in resource names.
